origin.summary: Workout 5 of the 2018 CrossFit Open. The Open is the worldwide online qualifying stage of the CrossFit Games season: one workout released each week, completed and scored by hundreds of thousands of athletes in affiliates and garages on the same few days.

description: A 7-minute ascending thruster-and-chest-to-bar-pull-up couplet, climbing by threes up to 18.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/open/2018/5 (official CrossFit Games Open workout), retrieved 2026-07-09; ascending ladder (+3 reps each round) continues indefinitely until the 7-minute cap
